Target CSV variable: kt
Local problem description: the peak-to-valley height, kt;
Problem domain/context: Perform dimensional analysis for sand-grain roughness parameterization to derive the dimensionless relationship governing the normalized equivalent sand-grain roughness (denoted as ks/Ra).
Analyzer interpretation: exact_column: kt; quantity_name: Peak-to-valley height (kt); physical_definition: Peak-to-valley height measured as the vertical distance between the highest peak and deepest valley over the surface sample.
